title: Sandy Buns | KEY.co
description_expanded: Villas at Seagrove rental, Sandy Buns, in Seagrove Beach, Florida, offers a luxurious escape in a gated community with deeded beach access just a short walk away. This four-bedroom, three-bathroom vacation home is designed to provide all the comforts of home, ensuring a relaxing and enjoyable stay. The spacious living area is perfect for gathering with loved ones, while the fully equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar and adjoining dining area invites delightful meals and cherished moments together. A large balcony provides a serene space to unwind and enjoy the coastal breeze. Each bedroom is thoughtfully appointed for comfort and convenience. The main bedroom features a king bed and an en suite bathroom, while the second bedroom also offers a king bed. The third bedroom includes a bunk bed, and the fourth bedroom boasts two queen beds, making it ideal for larger groups. With complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, a washer and dryer, and easy beach access just minutes from the front door, Sandy Buns ensures a memorable and stress-free vacation experience.
